annotation.title_clean: Ghana to Develop National AI Strategy Initiative Amid Digital Transformation Push
annotation.title_en: Ghana to Develop National AI Strategy Initiative Amid Digital Transformation Push
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Ministry of Communication, Digital Technology and Innovations, Ghana
annotation.venue: Ministry of Communication, Digital Technology and Innovations (moc.gov.gh)
annotation.summary_en: Ghana's Communications Ministry announces development of a National Digital Transformation and Emerging Technology Strategy and National AI Strategy, with UNESCO and British High Commission support. It stresses local data digitization, digital sovereignty, ethical AI, and legislative review. No robotics content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Ministry developing National AI Strategy with UNESCO and British High Commission
Digitization of national datasets so AI learns from local data and Indigenous knowledge
Review and redrafting of outdated technology laws
Complementary initiatives: One Million Coders Program and Ghana Innovation and Startup Bill
Emphasis on digital sovereignty and ethical, inclusive AI governance
